location_&_context.urban_context: Industrial riverfront context (Mill District), surrounded by historic mills, silos, agricultural ruins, factories, and adjacent to the Mississippi River

participants_&_operation.architect: Jean Nouvel (主導建築師), Architectural Alliance (在地合作事務所)
participants_&_operation.end_user: Audiences, Citizens, Actors, and Theater Company Personnel

intentions_diagram_couples.target_issue: 整合分散的劇院機能與工業歷史遺址紋理之對話
intentions_diagram_couples.architectural_metaphor_concept: 工業磨坊與筒倉的當代演繹
intentions_diagram_couples.tectonic_strategy: 以半圓形及矩形體量對應周邊筒倉與磨坊意象，並以懸挑鋼桁架構築延伸至河面

macro_level: Semi-cylindrical Volume → evoking the shapes of (Spatial_Massing_&_Conceptual_Relation) → Adjacent Grain Elevators
Rectework/Rectangular Volume → in harmony with (Spatial_Massing_&_Conceptual_Relation) → Nearby Flour Mills
Endless Bridge Cantilevered Structure → extending 178 feet from (Spatial_Massing_&_Conceptual_Relation) → Main Building Volume
meso_level: Escalators → providing visitors coherent spatial sequence to (Circulation_FOH) → Foyers and Performance Venues
Public Bridge / Endless Bridge → accessed without purchasing a ticket by (Circulation_FOH) → Citizen and Theatergoers
Skyway across Second Street → links core theater building to (Circulation_BOH) → Production and Support Facilities
BOH Backstage and Technical Areas → segregated from (Other_Meso_Programmatic_Separation) → FOH Public Foyers and Gathering Spaces
micro_level: Fiery Polychrome Irregular Polygons → break the rigidity of geometry in (Interface_Tectonic) → Wurtele Thrust Stage Auditorium
CENTRIA Formawall Dimension Panels → clad the exterior of (Interface_Tectonic) → Building Facade Walls
Supergraphic Images of Playwrights → screen printed on (Interface_Tectonic) → Metal Panels at Entrance Level
Mirrored Steel Frames → frame and refract city views at (Interface_Tectonic) → Windows

c3_typological_composition_logic.typology_diagram_note: 獨立劇場體量垂直堆疊，核心舞台幾何誠實外顯於皮層，並由巨大的都市公共懸挑橋橫向穿插。

d1_envelope_morphology.structure_integration_detail_note: 主體外殼包裹內部劇院盒子，端部 Endless Bridge 為獨立的懸挑鋼桁架結構（178英尺）外挑於基地。

foyer_promenade_phenomenology.experience_note: 超長電梯模擬穀物輸送帶，由暗轉明引導至前台，透過大窗與深藍、黃色玻璃渲染出不真實的都市全景。

acoustic_transition_threshold.experience_note: 觀眾在進入劇場前，於印有劇照剪影的牆面與低明度過渡空間中感受尺度的壓縮，完成觀劇前的心理緩衝。

auditorium_interior_enclosure.acoustic_material_integration: 不規則多邊形與舞動的吸音天花板，打破幾何剛性並完美回應不對稱的物理聲學反射要求。

d3_inside_out_integration_strategy.strategy_diagram_note: 藉由外部筒倉與磨坊形體誠實揭示內部劇場核心的排列，並利用夾縫空腔置入宛如工業步道的公共流線。

stakeholder_behavior_responses.spatial_behavior_action: 無需購買劇院門票即可自由進入 Endless Bridge 與黃色觀景盒，捕捉密西西比河與都市景觀。
在演出前後或中場休息時聚集於公共連通大廳、酒吧與露台，形成高度互動的社交與觀劇經驗。

discourse_polarity_criticism.summary_note: 建築成功演繹當地工業遺產紋理，帶動周邊老舊磨坊與筒倉的都市更新，建立全新的都市文化區。
